findings.issue: Index levels lacked a proper unit: Russell 2000 had none, and S&P 500 and VIX were written as bare "points".
findings.resolution: Changed to "index points" in three places. No other retail text changed.

findings.issue: Checked against notes/retail_2023-11-01, -02 and -03. ARKK is a new lead: on 2023-11-03 it was considered and rejected for lack of headline evidence, and the peak-rates theme appeared only as secondary items (TLT, Affirm). The promotion rests on newly published payroll and Fed-done evidence (n2064, n2063, n2065, n2066, n0134). Bitcoin, the 2023-11-01 lead, returns only as a secondary item on new verdict and ETF-listing evidence (n1079, n1080, n1074). The four narratives are distinct (rate-relief moonshots, Tesla dip-buy, sports-betting growth, bitcoin ETF calendar).
findings.resolution: Accepted. No change to notes/retail_2023-11-06.json, which matches the final draft.

findings.issue: Attention evidence is thin: seasonal coverage (n0612, n1825), the BofA losing-stocks list (n1008), the AMC turnaround question (n1009) and card-based leveraged-ETF moves (TQQQ +20.06%, SOXL +21.72%). No posts, counts or flows are invented, and behavioural claims are modal.
findings.resolution: Accepted as an honest, modal Social Signal. No change.

findings.issue: Weekend-stamped retail citations n1008, n1009, n1349, n1825 (2023-11-05) and n0996 (2023-11-04) are commentary or features whose subject predates the cutoff. The Friday-evening items are pre-cutoff: n2066 (Bloomberg evening briefing) and n1079 (AP, SBF verdict of 2023-11-02).

All retail numbers checked against the card (ARKK, UPST, AFRM, DASH, TQQQ, SOXL, TSLA, DKNG, BTC-USD, 10Y/2Y, S&P 500, Russell 2000, VIX) and the cited headlines. Titles follow Name / TICKER — hook with hooks of eight words or fewer. No hindsight: pending items (next inflation print, ETF approval) stay undated and pending.
